sector_notes: The 17 KBLI categories use the codes of data/20261102_bps-province-grdp-population, where MN and RSTU are the categories BPS prints as M,N and R,S,T,U. A numbered sub-category appends its number to its category (B2 = Pertambangan Batubara dan Lignit, coal and lignite mining), and a lettered item appends its letter to its sub-category (A1a = Tanaman Pangan). TOTAL is the province's GRDP, the table's last row. The sectors are those of data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-detailed-industry.

'label_raw' is each row's label_raw as BPS publishes it, the same in all 853 tables, and 'name' is the same text without the code a category prints. TOTAL's label_raw reads 'Produk Domestik Bruto', so TOTAL is named 'Produk Domestik Regional Bruto', as its HTML label and the sibling datasets name it.

Each level sums to its parent: the 17 categories to TOTAL, the numbered sub-categories to their category, and A1a-A1e to A1. Summing every row under A (A1, A1a-A1e, A2 and A3) would double count A1's items, so add up one level at a time.

grdp_current.table_en: Gross Regional Domestic Product at Current Market Prices by Industry in <province> Province (billion rupiahs), <year>
grdp_current.column: Produk Domestik Bruto/Produk Domestik Regional Bruto Atas Dasar Harga Berlaku
notes: The titles of 2020-2025 carry '(miliar rupiah)'; those of 2010-2019 print no unit, except one 2016 current-price table (36), and their unit is shown by their values, which equal vars 2267/2268 in Rp billion (checks.cross_source).

BPS publishes every value with 2 decimals; the CSV writes each value without trailing zeros, so a value BPS prints as 1.234,50 is written 1234.5. Some 2014 tables round their values to 0.1 or to whole Rp billion before printing them with 2 decimals (table_formats.printed_step).
BPS publishes no Indonesia row in these tables; the sum of provincial GRDP is not national GDP.

notes: The titles of 2020-2025 carry '(miliar rupiah)'; those of 2010-2019 print no unit, except one 2016 current-price table (36), and their unit is shown by their values, which equal vars 2267/2268 in Rp billion (checks.cross_source).

BPS publishes every value with 2 decimals; the CSV writes each value without trailing zeros, so a value BPS prints as 1.234,50 is written 1234.5. Some 2014 tables round their values to 0.1 or to whole Rp billion before printing them with 2 decimals (table_formats.printed_step).
BPS publishes no Indonesia row in these tables; the sum of provincial GRDP is not national GDP.

Each table list (ketersediaan_tahun) gives the years BPS publishes the table for: 2014-2025 for most provinces; 2010-2025 for 19 (Kepulauan Bangka Belitung) and 64 (Kalimantan Timur) at both prices and for 17 (Bengkulu) at current prices, whose constant-price table starts in 2015; 2015-2025 for 81 (Maluku), 91 (Papua Barat) and 94 (Papua); 2020-2025 for 92, 95, 96 and 97.
BPS serves 92, 95, 96 and 97 for 2020-2022 as empty shells (the row labels without values), so they have tables from 2023.

Excluded tables (excluded.tables) leave these years without rows: 17 at current prices in 2010-2014, 11, 19 and 72 in 2014 at both prices, and 14 at constant prices in 2014. 32 and 82 print '...' in every cell of their 2014 tables (unpublished_cells). So 11, 17, 32, 72 and 82 have rows from 2015, 14 has rows from 2014 at current prices and from 2015 at constant prices, and 19 has none for 2014.
Kalimantan Utara (65) has tables from 2014 only, and 64's tables leave it out in every year, so its values for 2010-2013 are in no table here (borders).

A province with a kept table in a year has a row for each of its 62 sectors except the cells listed in none_or_zero_cells, unpublished_cells and excluded.cells; completeness expects exactly this grid.

borders: 64 (Kalimantan Timur) excludes Kalimantan Utara in every year: its 2010-2013 tables equal vars 2267/2268's 64, which leave Kalimantan Utara out, and var 286's 64 of 2010-2012 equals this 64 plus vars 2267/2268's 65 (checks.cross_source). 65 (Kalimantan Utara) has its own tables from 2014.

91 (Papua Barat) and 94 (Papua) cover the pre-split provinces in their tables of 2015-2022: TOTAL equals vars 2267/2268 and var 286, both pre-split then. Their 2023-2025 tables cover the post-split areas: TOTAL of 2023 equals var 286's post-split 91 and 94 and differs from vars 2267/2268, which keep the pre-split areas in 2023. 92 (Papua Barat Daya), 95 (Papua Selatan), 96 (Papua Tengah) and 97 (Papua Pegunungan) have tables from 2023. checks.borders lists each year's TOTAL against both.

On the pre-split borders of 2023, 94 + 95 + 96 + 97 equals vars 2267/2268's 94 within rounding in every category and TOTAL; 91 + 92 equals their 91 within rounding except A and D at current prices (+5.00 and +0.10, TOTAL +5.10 Rp billion) and A at constant prices (+11.00, TOTAL +11.00), the gaps data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-2010-2025 finds between var 286's 91 + 92 and var 2268's 91.

A change of 91 or 94 from 2022 to 2023 compares different areas; the growth checks leave those changes out (checks.growth_not_compared). On fixed borders: Papua Barat (pre-2023 area) = 91 + 92 and Papua (pre-2023 area) = 94 + 95 + 96 + 97 from 2023.
These tables split Papua in 2023, as var 286 (data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-2010-2025) does, one year before vars 2267/2268 (data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-by-industry-2010-2025).

none_or_zero_cells.meaning: Tidak ada atau nol (none or zero)
none_or_zero_cells.rule: BPS prints these cells as an en dash with no value. They have no row in the CSV. An analysis may treat a listed cell as 0 Rp billion, as the identity checks do, except the cells under small_values. The tables of 2015 print 0,00 where the tables of other years print an en dash, and those zeros have rows.

small_values.rule: In the constant-price tables of 2016 and 2017 these cells are printed as an en dash, but the current-price cell holds a value and the category above includes it: they are small values BPS did not print, not zeros (checks.identities bounds each).

unpublished_cells.rule: Cells BPS prints with '...' (Data tidak tersedia, data not available) or 'NA' (Data tidak dapat ditampilkan, data cannot be shown). They have no row in the CSV and are not zeros. In 2014 '...' also stands in some tables where later tables print the en dash (18: B2 and C5).

excluded.rule: Cells BPS publishes that this dataset leaves out, because they are not GRDP in Rp billion at the table's price basis or do not add up within their own table; the build verifies each reason (checks.exclusions). The 17 categories and TOTAL of the excluded tables are in data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-by-industry-2010-2025.

reasons.million_rupiah: values in Rp million (juta rupiah), 1000 times the Rp billion of the series
reasons.current_in_constant: a constant-price table that prints current prices from a row through TOTAL
reasons.subcategories_sum_to_neither: sub-categories that are the same in the current-price and constant-price tables and sum to neither table's category
reasons.items_not_summing: items that do not sum to their sub-category, whose ratio to the constant-price cells lies far outside every other row of the table

source_tables.note: Each yearbook table's update times, versions (versi) and change logs (BPS's revision history), by indicator and year, as published; the status column follows each cell's marker, not the change log.

notes: Every value comes from the SIMDASI yearbook table of its province, year and price basis, so all rows of a table come from one table and its sums hold (checks.identities).

12 tables and 30 cells BPS publishes are left out (excluded): 11 tables in Rp million (17 at current prices in 2010-2014, and 11, 19 and 72 in 2014 at both prices), the constant-price table of 14 in 2014, which prints current prices from C9 on, the sub-categories of G, H, I and K of 61 in 2014 at both prices, and A1d and A1e of 35 at current prices in 2014. The 17 categories and TOTAL of the excluded tables are in data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-by-industry-2010-2025.

An en dash means none or zero, except 78 cells of the constant-price tables of 2016 and 2017 whose current-price cell holds a value (none_or_zero_cells.small_values): there the en dash hides a small value, so their sub-categories sum to up to 1.49 Rp billion less than the category.

Status is each cell's marker: * (Angka sementara) for 2024 and ** (Angka sangat sementara) for 2025; the cells of 2010-2023 carry no marker. Five cells carry no marker in 2024 or 2025 (table_formats.cells_without_their_years_marker) and are written with an empty status. The notes of the 2018 and 2019 tables state statuses for 2021 and 2022, years those tables do not hold.

The 17 categories and TOTAL equal vars 2267/2268 (data/20261103_bps-province-grdp-by-industry-2010-2025) within the rounding of each table on the same borders, except the tables in checks.cross_source declared under REVISION_GAPS: 31 in 2014 (whole Rp billion, an earlier revision, up to 0.91) and 76 (Sulawesi Barat) in 2022 at both prices (A and C split differently, 5.40) and in 2023 and 2024 at constant prices (0.37 and 1.32 at TOTAL). checks.cross_source lists every difference.

Derived values are not stored. Sector share (%) = grdp_current of the sector / grdp_current of TOTAL x 100; real growth (%) = (grdp_constant_2010 in year t / grdp_constant_2010 in year t-1 - 1) x 100; implicit price deflator (2010 = 100) = grdp_current / grdp_constant_2010 x 100.

checks.flags lists every value or change outside its range in checks.plausible_ranges for a person to review, and a growth or share flag gives the two values it compares under rp_billion; a flag stays whether it reflects a real event or a source error.
